हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Aarav Verma was once a helpless young man, mocked as a "madman" after his family's tragic downfall. But a divine intervention sent his soul to Amarlok, where he trained under mystical fairies to become a powerful warrior. He returned to Earth with a secret mission: recover three lost celestial weapons and avenge his parents.
